appearance_facts.fact: A blue line connects dark blue circular markers, extending from the left side of the chart to the right side.
The axis labels are arranged in reverse numerical order from top to bottom: 0.0 is at the top, followed by 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, and 2.5 at the bottom.
The line begins at the left (Year 2000.0) at a vertical position aligned with approximately 1.3 on the axis.
The line descends visually towards the bottom of the chart as it moves to the right (Year 2017.5).
The final marker at Year 2017.5 is positioned lower on the page than the initial marker, aligning with the 2.5 tick mark.
A light purple/blue shaded region fills the area above the line, extending up to the 0.0 axis limit.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads: 'Year vs. Number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants'
Y-axis label is 'Count' with tick marks labeled 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5.

uncertain: The Y-axis is inverted (0.0 at top, 2.5 at bottom), which makes the visual 'descent' of the line correspond to an increase in the numeric value from ~1.3 to ~2.4.
